about_the_game:
It all started as friendly competitions between engineers. Over time paradigms became enforced, battles grew, and innovation ceased.

By the turn of the 22nd century society had divided into 3 houses, who now battle for supremacy within the arena . . .

Play as an up-and-coming Robo-Master. Make an avatar and select your House.

Build a fanbase and manage the media. Land sponsorships to earn extra cash.

Play against a wide variety of AI opponents, and discover their tendencies and weaknesses.

Battle to victory and advance through the Midway Circuit and the Super League!

Win multiple championships to earn the ultimate title: the Super Ace!
